current.text: Portland's projected starting five is Lillard, Morant, Camara, Avdija and Clingan. Henderson comes off the bench.
Portland's backcourt is crowded with high-usage guards: Damian Lillard, Ja Morant, Jrue Holiday and Deni Avdija share the ball with Henderson, and Shaedon Sharpe is also off the bench.
Veteran guards keep blocking his path. He projects as a 20-minute bench player with few chances and is not draftable.
Minutes and usage are expected to swing from game to game across the Portland rotation.
Portland has a new head coach this season.
He has no injury status and is expected to be available for a full season.
Portland has been rumored in a trade for Jaylen Brown. Such a deal would likely send out Henderson or another guard.
Experts disagree on a trade. One calls him a likely trade piece if Portland goes after Jaylen Brown. Another doubts Portland makes a consolidation trade.
Only 47.3% of his potential assists turn into assists. This is likely tied to poor finishing by teammates such as Donovan Clingan and Toumani Camara.
Portland has three back-to-backs in the fantasy playoff weeks.
